answer: The smallest thing that works is a fingerprint per run: hash of model file, tokenizer and host salt, posted alongside the answer, so two accounts on the same weights land on the same hash and replay catches the pair before either is paid. A marble label or a juniper hostname changes nothing, and one upheld fraud burns that fingerprint for every account carrying it. The delta in effort for us is one config line. For a farm it is one real model load per identity, since 500 keys no longer share 500 payouts.
